comparison: Read-only comparison of FirstPerson.cpp, FirstPersonBodyIK.h, BodyFollower.h and VRSystem.cpp against current code
findings: Older SolveFollowingBody used the same native eye offset as the camera and did not apply the later standing chest reserve.
Later standing calibration added torso fitting and a persistent eye reserve; earlier landing fixes removed their impact contribution.

The successful supported-leg fix restricts further impact hip compression. The subsequent camera-only head-height patch did not update the body eye reference, nor account for physical lowering after the scene anchor.
Current correction shares the landing eye offset with VRIK, retains the authored impact torso bend, and bounds the final tracked eye using the same scaled foot-supported pose.
notClaimed: This is not a full historical rollback or a claim that the entire old release has been headset-reproduced.
